annotations.title: French insolvency claim deadline lookup (BODACC, by SIREN)

description: Use this when you need to know whether a French company is in insolvency proceedings and until what date a creditor can still file its claim. For 1 to 50 SIREN: proceedings published in the BODACC (safeguard, receivership, liquidation) and, for each opening judgment, the exact last day to file (2 months after publication, 4 if the creditor is abroad; art. R622-24 Code de commerce), days left, appointed liquidator and notice link. For credit managers, accountants, debt collectors. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402).

residence.description: Where the creditor lives: metropole (default), etranger (abroad), or an overseas code (971 to 978, 986 to 988). Two more months when it differs from the court's territory

sirens.description: 1 to 50 SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits), comma-separated

name: creances_lookup

licence.description: Licence of the source data: nom, url, source, attribution (the credit the licence requires)

marche_a_suivre.description: How to file the claim (French), only when a window is open

annulations_verifiees.description: False when the search for cancellation and correction notices timed out: check the deadlines on the notice

annule_par.description: Cancellation notice: this notice is void and opens no window

date_limite_declaration.description: Last day to file the claim

delai_compte_depuis.description: Correction whose original notice is missing: deadline counted from the original publication

nature.description: Judgment type as worded in the BODACC (French)

rectifie_par.description: Correction notices, latest first, each with its own texte_du_jugement; the deadline still runs from this, earlier, notice

releve_de_forclusion_jusqu_au.description: Last day to ask the court to lift the time bar

report_possible_jour_chome.description: Later date if the weekend/holiday extension applies; not guaranteed

texte_du_jugement.description: Judgment text, names the liquidator (French). When texte_du_rectificatif is present, read it too: the correction may name another one
